name: Greek Beef Moussaka with Eggplant and Béchamel

components.name: Beef Moussaka

ingredients.name: Beef stock instead of red wine

steps: Cut eggplant into 6 mm slices, sprinkle lightly with measured salt and rest briefly. Pat dry, brush with olive oil and roast at 205 C until softened and lightly coloured.
While the eggplant cooks, soften onion in oil, brown beef, then add tomato, stock and warm spices. Simmer until the filling is thick rather than watery.
To make béchamel whisk flour into warm olive oil, then gradually add milk; whisk constantly until thick. Remove from heat and gradually temper in the beaten eggs with the nutmeg and salt.
Layer half the eggplant, then the meat sauce, then remaining eggplant in a baking dish. Spread béchamel over the top and finish with measured breadcrumbs.
Bake at 180 C about 35-45 minutes until golden and set. Rest 15 minutes before slicing.
Cut into six lunch-size portions; refrigerate promptly, or freeze fully cooled squares.

Adapted full-size moussaka inspired by The Mediterranean Dish. The original recipe uses a large pan and 12 pieces; UNHANGRY portions into six complete meals with recipe quantities adjusted.
Planning: SECONDARY STOVETOP: cook meat sauce and béchamel.
Freezer: freezes particularly well in individual slices
Dietary: Contains dairy, eggs and wheat. No wine in UNHANGRY batch.
Keeps 3–4 days in the fridge (≤4°C); refrigerate within 2 hours (1 hour above 32°C) in shallow containers, freeze portions for later in the week, and reheat to at least 74°C.
